title: Over 1,500 tobacco farmers in Ilocos Sur receive financial aid

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The municipal government of Sinait in Ilocos Sur distributed financial assistance to 1,593 tobacco farmers in recognition of their contribution to the agriculture sector and local economy. The two-day distribution, held at the Municipal Auditorium, was led by Mayor Glenn Guzman through the Municipal Agriculture Office. Guzman assured the farmers that the local government was also preparing additional assistance, including fuel and fertilizer, to support their farming activities.
